top_headline: مجموعة طلعت مصطفى القابضة (TMGH.CA) تعلن نتائج أعمالها المجمعة عن 9 أشهر
llm_summary:
- Egyptian billionaires and prominent businessmen, including Mohamed Mansour, have donated a total of EGP 30 million ($186,000) to support the victims of the fire near the Ring Road in Giza.
- The donations are a collective effort from leading businessmen, with each individual contributing EGP 10 million.
- The fire incident has led to a show of solidarity, with the Talaat Moustafa Group (TMG) and singer Tamer Hosny postponing their concert in Madinaty to December 4th, in support of the victims' families.
- The concert's tickets will remain valid for the rescheduled date, demonstrating the group's commitment to the community.
- This incident highlights the social responsibility and generosity of Egyptian tycoons, with businessmen like Mohamed Mansour, Yasseen Mansour, Ahmed Ezz, and Hisham Talaat Mo stepping up to help.
- The Egyptian government has received these donations and initiatives from the business community, aiming to support those affected by the Ring Road tragedy.
- The Prime Minister has directed the Ministry of Social Solidarity to ensure the donations reach the intended beneficiaries.
- The news also showcases the collaboration between real estate developers and other industries, as "Talal Mustafa" and "Azarab" partner to offer electric luxury cars to residents of their projects, promoting a vision of modern, sustainable living.
